experiment_data.hypothesis: Random pruning at k=0.7 on OpenVLA libero_object will show significant performance degradation compared to attention-based pruning at the same ratio, confirming that importance-aware token selection is critical at high compression levels. Replication on westd-41074.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 MUJOCO_GL=egl python -u eval_openvla_l2norm_libero.py --mode random_prune --k_ratio 0.7 --suite libero_object --num_episodes 50 --seed 42
